items.title: Meta Ads: $251.65 spend, 15 leads, $16.78 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: This run covers 2026-08-14 through 2026-08-18 (5 days) because the prior meta-ads.json was from 2026-08-14 (covering 2026-08-13), so the window was widened to close the gap. Across that window Meta spent $251.65 on the only actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 15 leads at $16.78 CPL — about 15% above the 7-day baseline CPL of $14.58 (24 leads / $349.93), not enough to trigger an anomaly. Account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: Gap since last successful run: prior meta-ads.json was dated 2026-08-14 (covered 2026-08-13). This run widened the pull to --days 5 (2026-08-14 through 2026-08-18, i.e. yesterday) to close the gap, staying under the 7-day cap. The 7-day baseline call (2026-08-12 through 2026-08-18) used for CPL comparison overlaps this window by design.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 15 over this window and 24 over the 7-day baseline, matching the counted leads exactly both times). Same discrepancy was flagged in the 2026-08-14 run and remains unresolved — likely the script's lead-action set needs extending, not hand-patched here.
